rules:
Rules
SLOSHED HOUSE RULES

Pull up a stool, read the sign, respect the bar.

18+ Only

If you can't legally order a drink, you can't order a vibe. This is an adults-only establishment.

No Racism, Hate Speech, or Discrimination

Racism, sexism, homophobia, transphobia, ableism, or any other form of discrimination earns an immediate trip out the door.

No Harassment

Friendly roasting is fine. Bullying, intimidation, targeted harassment, stalking, or making others uncomfortable is not.

Respect Different Beliefs

Everyone comes from different backgrounds. Debate ideas respectfully, but don't attack people for their religion, morals, politics, culture, or personal values.

This Ain't Tinder

Don't treat the server like a dating app. Respect boundaries and take "no" for an answer the first time.

Respect Staff

Mods and Admins are here to keep the drinks flowing, not babysit. Follow staff instructions and use ModMail if you have concerns.

Lurkers Welcome

You don't have to chat to be part of the community. Just be verified and follow the rules.

Use the Correct Channels

Keep conversations where they belong. Off-topic discussions, media, memes, and support requests all have their own spaces.

No Doxxing, Threats, or Hacking

Sharing personal information, threatening users, account theft, hacking, or malicious activity results in an immediate permanent ban.

No Drama Farming

Keep personal disputes out of the server. We're here to socialize, not host public feuds.

Ask If You're Unsure

If you don't know whether something is allowed, ask a Moderator or Admin before doing it.

Staff Accountability

Staff members are held to a higher standard. Abuse of power may result in loss of permissions or removal from staff.

Don't Ruin the Vibe

If you're consistently disruptive, toxic, or trying to make the community worse, expect consequences.
